sections.title: Text inputs
sections.description: Labels stay visible. Hints explain the expected format before an error occurs.
sections.specification: control.height 32 / 40 / 48 · radius 6 · border 1 subtle · padding-x 14 · gap 8
sections.usage: Subtle neutral boundaries match the surrounding containers; hover and focus strengthen the field outline. The focus indicator uses the text color, with a 3 px offset ring; brand violet is reserved for actions and selected values.

sections.title: Field states
sections.description: Default, hover, focus, filled, invalid, read-only and disabled.
sections.specification: border default: color.border · hover: color.borderHover · invalid: color.error · focus: text / 3 px
sections.usage: Errors use text and an icon as well as color. Disabled controls do not accept interaction; read-only values can still be copied.

sections.title: Text areas & number controls
sections.description: Long prompts need room. Numeric values need clear limits and units.
sections.specification: textarea min-height 112 · number min 1 / max 12 · label 14 / 500 · body 16
sections.usage: Keep length limits visible. Use numeric controls for quantities, never account numbers or identifiers.

sections.title: Selects, dropdowns & multi-select
sections.description: Use a select for a single value and a checkbox group for multiple selections.
sections.specification: menu radius 10 · option min-height 40 · padding 8 · elevation overlay · neutral border
sections.usage: Keep menu width aligned with its trigger. Use visible selection marks. The open specimen documents layout; native controls above provide the interactive examples.

sections.title: Checkboxes, radios & switches
sections.description: Different selection rules deserve different controls.
sections.specification: checkbox / radio 18 · target min 44 · switch 36 × 22 · label-gap 10
sections.usage: Checkboxes allow multiple values; radios allow one per group. Switches apply immediately. Group related options with a fieldset and legend.

sections.title: Date, time, range & color pickers
sections.description: Use familiar native pickers with explicit labels and an always-visible value.
sections.specification: date / time: control.height · calendar cell 36 · range target 44 · color swatch 40 × 40 · gap 8
sections.usage: The browser supplies the calendar and clock UI. Format dates for the viewer and store unambiguous values. Do not use color alone to name a selection.

sections.title: Upload & attachment states
sections.description: A file input, selected-file feedback and a visible removal action.
sections.specification: drop zone min-height 160 · radius 10 · border 1 dashed · neutral surface
sections.usage: This demo reads file names and sizes locally; it does not upload files. Validate type and size again on the server in a real product.

sections.title: A complete form
sections.description: Submit to see field-level errors and a success state. Nothing is sent.
sections.specification: form field-gap 24 · label-gap 8 · section-gap 32 · required marker explained
sections.usage: Validate on submit, keep entered values, focus the first invalid control and associate each error with its field. Success is announced without losing context.

sections.title: Containers, borders & spacing
sections.description: The same quiet foundation supports every form.
sections.specification: space 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64 · container padding 24 · control border 1
sections.usage: Use dividers for grouping and subtle neutral resting borders for controls, with stronger hover and focus treatment. Do not tint input borders or shadows violet just to make them feel branded.

sections.title: Buttons & action hierarchy
sections.description: One primary action per decision area. Explore sizes with the control above.
sections.specification: height 32 / 40 / 48 · padding-x 14 / 16 / 20 · radius 6 · icon 20 · gap 8
sections.usage: Primary uses the action token. Secondary uses neutral borders, tertiary uses text. Destructive red is reserved for destructive intent. The traveling light is optional decoration, disabled for reduced motion.

sections.title: Action states
sections.description: Compare state treatments without relying only on color.
sections.specification: hover: neutral overlay · pressed: inset shadow · focus: 3 px text-color ring / 3 px offset
sections.usage: Loading preserves button width and explains the task. Disabled controls have a documented reason in the surrounding UI. Never remove keyboard focus styling.

sections.title: Dropdown menus & popovers
sections.description: Actions sit in menus. Supplementary explanations sit in popovers.
sections.specification: trigger min-height 40 · menu min-width 200 · option min-height 40 · elevation overlay
sections.usage: Use a native select for values and a menu for actions. Keep menus inside the viewport. Popovers dismiss with Escape or an outside click.

sections.title: Navigation, tabs & breadcrumbs
sections.description: Make location and the active destination visible.
sections.specification: tabs height 44 · active underline 2 · breadcrumb gap 8 · segment radius 6
sections.usage: Tabs switch panels in the same context. Breadcrumbs show hierarchy. Segmented buttons change a local view. Arrow keys move between tabs.

sections.title: Toasts & inline notifications
sections.description: Feedback names the outcome and gives a next step when needed.
sections.specification: toast width min(380 px, viewport − 32 px) · padding 16 · radius 14 · icon badge 32 / glyph 18
sections.usage: Status uses a compact icon, clear content and a uniform subtle outline, without an accent stripe. Toasts are dismissible and remain until dismissed in this demo. Keep critical errors inline and do not rely on transient feedback.

sections.title: Modal dialogs & side panels
sections.description: Use a modal for a focused decision, a drawer for contextual details.
sections.specification: dialog width min(480 px, viewport − 32 px) · padding 24 · radius 16 · elevation modal
sections.usage: Native dialog provides modal focus containment and Escape dismissal. Return focus to the trigger on close. Keep destructive confirmation specific to the action.

sections.title: Tables, sorting, filters & pagination
sections.description: Dense information still needs a readable rhythm.
sections.specification: row min-height 56 · cell padding 12 / 16 · header 14 / 600 · divider 1 · 3 rows per demo page
sections.usage: Sort controls expose their direction. Filters reset pagination. Selection applies to the visible page; checkbox names identify their rows. Empty results are explicit.

sections.title: Tags, avatars & progress
sections.description: Soft tinted fills distinguish semantic statuses; neutral tags stay gray.
sections.specification: tag height 28 · tinted fill / subtle semantic border · avatar 32 · progress height 6 · steps gap 24 · spinner 18
sections.usage: Show percentages only for measured progress. Indeterminate loading uses a spinner and a task label. Never imply a generated estimate is actual progress.

sections.title: Empty, loading, error & success states
sections.description: Explain what happened and what someone can do next.
sections.specification: state padding 32 · icon 40 · heading 20 / 650 · text max-width 32 ch · action gap 16
sections.usage: A zero state, no search results, permission issue and network failure need different copy. Skeletons match the expected content shape; reduced motion removes shimmer.

sections.title: Cards, accordions, tooltips & shortcuts
sections.description: Progressive disclosure keeps secondary information close.
sections.specification: card radius 10 · content padding 24 · accordion target 44 · tooltip 12 / 16 · shadow overlay
sections.usage: Tooltips appear on hover and keyboard focus; they must not contain essential instructions. Accordions use native disclosure behavior. Shortcut labels supplement a visible action.

sections.title: Elevation, borders & layers
sections.description: Depth comes from neutral shadows and clear surface roles.
sections.specification: shadow color neutral black · decorative border color.divider · field border color.border
sections.usage: In dark mode, surface contrast and borders carry more of the separation. Never use colored glow as the default elevation. Native dialogs and popovers use the browser top layer.

sections.title: Layout & spacing in context
sections.description: A small workspace composition brings the components together.
sections.specification: shell gap 24 · sidebar 160 · content padding 24 · page heading 24 / 700 · section-gap 32
sections.usage: Keep most surfaces neutral, use violet for the primary action and selected states, and use semantic colors only when the information has that meaning.
